It said that a ship would come seeking shelter on the next moonless night, carrying a girl who had lost her way. The keeper looked out at the dark horizon, unsure whether the note was a warning or a memory. At midnight, a small light appeared beyond the waves. He opened the harbor gate and prepared a warm room. By dawn, a stranger stood at his door, holding a matching bottle.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市还没有完全醒来。路灯把淡黄的光铺在空荡的街道上，几辆早班公交悄悄驶过。便利店亮着白色灯光，店员整理刚送来的面包。高楼的窗户大多沉在黑暗里，偶尔有一扇窗映出忙碌的身影。清洁工推着车，扫去昨夜留下的落叶；远处传来鸟鸣，像是城市轻轻呼吸。天边渐渐泛起青灰色，屋檐与树梢慢慢显出轮廓。凌晨的城市安静而温柔，藏着无数尚未讲述的故事，也为新一天悄悄做好准备。","w03":"- Recursion is when a set of instructions solves a problem by using a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine opening a box that contains a smaller box, then another, until you reach a tiny toy.\n- To finish, solve the tiniest box first, then work back through each bigger box."}
